title: Roche HyperPrep Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: In the script there is a setting definition for the number of samples (SAMPLES = 8x, 16x, or 24x). Samples are prepared as below, with 50ul of 100ng of fragmented sample DNA. See the Roche/KAPA HyperPrep protocol for more information about sample input requirements. * * Plate Moving The Protocol requires manually transferring the sample plate between the Thermocycler and Magnet 3 times. It starts on the Thermocycler and needs to be moved to the Magnet for the post-ligation cleanup, and then moved to the Thermocycler for PCR and then back to the Magnet for the post-PCR cleanup. In the script the two positions are handled as sample_plate_mag and sample_plate_thermo; during calibration use an empty plate of the same labware as the sample plate on the magnet position to allow calibration. * Tip Tracking Tip Tracking is an option meant to reuse tips for repeated washes. Instead of discarding tips the OT2 will replace them in their original location for repeated use, this reduces the number of tips needed and allows a 24 sample run to require no tiprack replacements. To prevent cross contamination when reusing Tips, when running the protocol with tip reuse, the reservoir is a 96x 2ml deepwell plate instead of a 12x well 15ml plate. See Reservoir for more details. * Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Samples`: Specify number of samples 8, 16, or 24. * `Dry Run`: Specify whether performing a dry run or not. * `Modules or no modules`: YES or NO, 'YES' will not require modules on the deck and will skip module steps, for testing purposes, if DRY RUN is 'YES', then NO MODULES will automatically set itself to 'NO' * `Reuse tips`: YES or NO, Reusing tips on wash steps reduces tips needed, no tip refill needed, suggested only for 24x run with all steps * `Offset`: YES or NO, Sets whether to use protocol specific z offsets for each tip and labware or no offsets aside from defaults * `Include ERAT`: Steps with "DECK" are for reaction to take place with the on deck

steps.title: Prepare DNA samples
steps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µL of fragmented DNA containing 100 ng per sample into each well of the sample plate.

steps.title: Load deck and calibrate magnet position
steps.instruction: Place the sample plate on the Thermocycler position of the OT‑2 deck. For calibration, put an empty plate of the same type on the Magnet position (sample_plate_mag). Load source tuberacks on slots 1‑2, a PCR plate on slot 3, and the appropriate reservoir (96‑well 2 mL deepwell if tip reuse is enabled, otherwise a 12‑well 15 mL plate).

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 script specify: Number of Samples (8, 16, or 24); Dry Run (YES/NO); Modules (YES/NO – automatically set to NO if Dry Run is YES); Reuse Tips (YES/NO – recommended for 24‑sample runs); Offset (YES/NO); Include ERAT (YES/NO).

steps.title: Transfer samples to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2, move liquid from the source tuberacks (slots 1‑2) to the PCR plate (slot 3), dispensing down columns then across rows.

steps.title: Post‑ligation magnetic cleanup – first transfer
steps.instruction: Manually move the sample plate from the Thermocycler to the Magnet position for the post‑ligation cleanup.

steps.title: Remove waste after ligation
steps.instruction: On the magnetic module, aspirate supernatant from each well without contacting the bead pellet and discard to waste.

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Manually move the sample plate back to the Thermocycler and run the PCR program as defined in the Roche/KAPA HyperPrep protocol.

steps.title: Post‑PCR magnetic cleanup – second transfer
steps.instruction: Manually move the sample plate from the Thermocycler to the Magnet position for the post‑PCR cleanup.

steps.title: Remove waste after PCR
steps.instruction: On the magnetic module, aspirate supernatant from each well without contacting the bead pellet and discard to waste.

steps.title: Tip reuse handling
steps.instruction: If Reuse Tips is set to YES, the OT‑2 will return tips to their original locations for repeated wash steps, using the 96‑well 2 mL deepwell reservoir; otherwise discard tips after each use.

steps.title: Finalize run
steps.instruction: Return the sample plate to its final location, ensure all tips are either discarded or stored per the Reuse Tips setting, and record completion of the protocol.
